ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Re-using water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Weather its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Recording weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Interpreting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
